name: Shojo Bitch Darake no Tennis-bu Gasshuku! ~Atashi ga Shojo Datte Shouko ga Doko ni An no yo!?~
original_name: 処女ビッチだらけのテニス部合宿！ ～アタシが処女だって証拠がドコにあんのよ!?～
source:
The protagonist, Sano Yuuto, is an ordinary male student with a medium build, unremarkable looks, and is average at both academics and sports.
However, even if he himself may not stand out, his sisters certainly do.
His older sister, Arika, and younger sister, Miaka, are just one year above and below the protagonist.
Both are so beautiful that it's hard to believe they're related to him, and they dress and look flashy.
They're also fashion-conscious, so they have many female entourages and are very popular in the tennis club they belong to.
Naturally, there are constant rumors about both of them having relationships with other boys.
However, the older sister has a problem that she can't tell anyone about.

Arika, who has a flashy appearance and appears to have a lot of experience, is actually a virgin with no experience at all!
The older sister, who is unable to admit it due to the misunderstandings from those around her, is actually weak when it comes to men's gazes, and as a result, she doesn't perform well in official tennis matches.
So, in an effort to overcome her weaknesses for this summer's tournament, the nervous older sister takes action... and decides to "become a bitch with real experience with men" during training camp!
And the protagonist, who has been made to be the tennis club manager, ends up being her partner!?
Arika's rival, the elegant and refined captain of the tennis club, Yukari.

And with the younger sister, classmates, and even the advisor dragged aside, the "bitch" training camp begins...!

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=794369]Getchu[/url]]
